name: Dynamic B - Production valve closure (illustrative)
description: Base dynamic system. Close PWV-101 (or PMV-101) and compare the response on BOTH sides of the valve: build-up upstream, line-pack drain-down and boundary settling downstream, flow decay along the flowline. All data ILLUSTRATIVE.
briefing: Watch PT-102 (upstream of choke), PT-103 (downstream), PT-202 (flowline mid-point) and FT-101 while PWV-101 closes.
Upstream volumes pack up; downstream the flowline drains to the manifold until it settles at boundary pressure plus hydrostatic head.
The 'valve reached position' event and the 'process settled' event are logged separately.
